title: Quando lieta sperai (Rore)
desc: Cipriano de Rore, Quando lieta sperai, before 1560. 5 voices (Cantus, Altus, Quintus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0027); edited by Maxime Popineau, Vincent Besson, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
